report.title: BUG: keep-all broke after punctuation where no break is allowed in 5 of 5 boxes
report.log:
"가격 1,000,000원"
  expected ["가격 ","1,000,000원"]
  actual   ["가격 1,","000,","000원"]  <-- differs
"원주율 3.14159265"
  expected ["원주율 ","3.14159265"]
  actual   ["원주율 3.","14159265"]  <-- differs
"미국 U.S.A.U.S.A."
  expected ["미국 ","U.S.A.U.S.A."]
  actual   ["미국 U.S.","A.U.S.A."]  <-- differs
"시간 12:30:45:00"
  expected ["시간 ","12:30:45:00"]
  actual   ["시간 12:","30:45:","00"]  <-- differs
"서울 (대한민국)"
  expected ["서울 ","(대한민국)"]
  actual   ["서울 (","대한민국)"]  <-- differs
